text.card: A red giant 3,595 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 0.86 solar masses and 10.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,978 K at its surface.
